---
title: "Software"

I develop and contribute to open-source tools for linear kinetic plasma physics,
turbulence analysis, and multi-spacecraft measurements.

## <img src="images/PLUME_logo.png" alt="PLUME logo" style="height: 42px; vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 0.5em;"> PLUME

**Plasma in a Linear Uniform Magnetized Environment** is a numerical solver
for the Vlasov–Maxwell dispersion relation in hot magnetized plasmas. It supports
multiple drifting bi-Maxwellian plasma components and arbitrary wave propagation directions.

[Source code and documentation](https://github.com/kgklein/PLUME) ·
[Software DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15215514)

## <img src="images/ALPS_logo.png" alt="ALPS logo" style="height: 42px; vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 0.5em;"> ALPS

**Arbitrary Linear Plasma Solver** is an open-source dispersion solver designed
to investigate wave behavior and kinetic stability for general gyrotropic velocity distributions.

[Source code and documentation](https://danielver02.github.io/) ·
[Software DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17477418)

## <img src="images/HS001-logo_FinalBlackA.png" alt="HelioSwarm Observatory logo" style="height: 42px; vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 0.5em;"> HelioSwarm Synthetic Observatory

Tools for generating, analyzing, visualizing, and reproducing synthetic
multi-spacecraft plasma measurements in preparation for HelioSwarm science.

[Documentation](https://kgklein.github.io/hs-observatory/)
